capital_rotation.methodology: flow is classified on relative_change_pct = token volume change minus the universe median change, so a market-wide move (or a volume-source shift in the feed) does not read as rotation. volume_change_pct is the raw window-over-window change for reference.

candles_180d.ohlc_note: high/low are the max/min of prices we sampled within each bucket (true intra-bar range at our collection cadence — see n_ticks — not exchange tick-by-tick data). A bucket with n_ticks=1 has high==low==open==close.
candles_180d.volume_semantics: rolling_24h_usd_snapshot_at_bucket_close — this is NOT per-bucket traded volume and must not be summed across candles.
